observation.visible_scene: A round metal pot filled with water sits on a lit gas-stove burner; a blue flame is visible at the pot's base in many frames. To the right is a patterned tile counter with another metal vessel, and a black stove control knob is partly visible at the lower left. The water surface is active with rising bubbles and a hazy layer of steam/mist above it throughout the clip.
visible_changes: The water is in a sustained boil: bubbles churn and rise across the surface, with the bubbling pattern changing from frame to frame but the overall activity level remaining steady.
A translucent steam/mist layer persists above the water, its density and shape fluctuating slightly between frames.
The blue flame beneath the pot remains present, flickering in visibility as the camera angle shifts.

The framing drifts subtly (handheld camera motion): the pot shifts within the frame and the left black control knob moves toward and partly out of the left edge from the early frames to the later frames, while the right-side vessel and tile pattern stay largely in place.
The water level and the pot's position on the burner appear essentially unchanged over the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the boil had just begun or was already long-running before this segment, and whether it continues or is turned off afterward.
Any action of adding ingredients, covering, or removing the pot, which is not shown.
The cause of the heating (the burner is lit but no operator or ignition is seen).
uncertain_details: It is unclear whether the small positional shifts of the pot are due to camera drift or actual movement of the pot on the burner; background evidence is limited.
Minor variations in apparent water level between frames may be perspective/lighting artifacts rather than real evaporation.
